en.t: Such attempts to keep him there were nothing unusual.

units.source_text: 日子渐久，这种消息自然传到左大臣邸中。

en.t: As time went on, news of this naturally reached the Minister of the Left's residence.

units.source_text: 于是葵姬的侍女们便纷纷议论：“这女人到底是谁呀？

en.t: Then Lady Aoi's attendants began whispering among themselves, "Who on earth is this woman?

units.source_text: 从来不曾听见这个人的名字。

en.t: We have never even heard this person's name before.

units.source_text: 如此善于撒娇撒痴，把公子迷住，

en.t: She must be so skilled at playing the coy fool and acting spoiled that she has bewitched the young lord,

units.source_text: 一定不是一个身份高贵的上流女子。

en.t: so she surely cannot be a highborn lady of noble rank.

units.source_text: 想是他在宫中不知什么地方偶然看到一个侍女，

en.t: Most likely he happened to see some maidservant somewhere in the palace,

units.source_text: 便宠爱了她，生怕外人非难，

en.t: then took a fancy to her and feared that outsiders would criticize him,

units.source_text: 所以一向隐藏，假意说她还是一个不懂人事的孩子。”

en.t: and so he has kept her hidden all along, pretending that she is still only an innocent child who knows nothing of adult affairs."
